---
title: "Dr. Thomley's Fall 2026 Schedule"
output: html_document
---

<hr>

The number of office hours offered in a given semester is a function of the class credit hours a professor is teaching. Additional hours are available to students in my hybrid STT 1810. You can book Help Hours appointments in 15-minute increments via Canvas.

```{r, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(kableExtra)
```

```{r, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}
data <- read_xlsx(
  "schedule.xlsx",
  sheet = 1
) %>%
  replace(is.na(.), " ") %>%
  mutate(
    Monday = cell_spec(Monday,
      background =
        case_when(
          Monday == "STT 1810" ~ "#FFCC00",
          Monday == "STT 4811" ~ "#d7a527",
          Monday == "Help Hours" ~ "#d5c99a",
          Monday == "Meeting" ~ "#d6d6d7",
          .default = "#00000000"
        )
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Tuesday = cell_spec(Tuesday,
      background =
        case_when(
          Tuesday == "STT 1810" ~ "#FFCC00",
          Tuesday == "STT 4811" ~ "#d7a527",
          Tuesday == "Help Hours" ~ "#d5c99a",
          Tuesday == "Meeting" ~ "#d6d6d7",
          .default = "#00000000"
        )
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Wednesday = cell_spec(Wednesday,
      background =
        case_when(
          Wednesday == "STT 1810" ~ "#FFCC00",
          Wednesday == "STT 4811" ~ "#d7a527",
          Wednesday == "Help Hours" ~ "#d5c99a",
          Wednesday == "Meeting" ~ "#d6d6d7",
          .default = "#00000000"
        )
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Thursday = cell_spec(Thursday,
      background =
        case_when(
          Thursday == "STT 1810" ~ "#FFCC00",
          Thursday == "STT 4811" ~ "#d7a527",
          Thursday == "Help Hours" ~ "#d5c99a",
          Thursday == "Meeting" ~ "#d6d6d7",
          .default = "#00000000"
        )
    )
    ) %>%
    mutate(
    Friday = cell_spec(Friday,
      background =
        case_when(
          Friday == "STT 1810" ~ "#FFCC00",
          Friday == "STT 4811" ~ "#d7a527",
          Friday == "Help Hours" ~ "#d5c99a",
          Friday == "Meeting" ~ "#d6d6d7",
          .default = "#00000000"
            )
        )
      )
```

```{r, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}
kable(data,
  format = "html",
  escape = FALSE,
  align = "cccccc"
) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive"))
```
